items.requirements: Gigabit (10/100/1000) Ethernet switch with at least 8 ports, of which at least 5 supply IEEE 802.3af or 802.3at (PoE/PoE+) power; total PoE budget at least 30 W. Fast-Ethernet-only (10/100) switches are not acceptable because the cameras are GigE Vision. Must support jumbo frames (9K or more) for the machine-vision cameras. Unmanaged is fine; managed is acceptable at a similar price. Must be a complete working switch including its power adapter (most PoE switches use an external power brick; a used listing without it is a part-only deal). Avoid passive / 24 V non-standard PoE and no-name brands with unverifiable PoE budgets; established brands (TP-Link, Netgear, Ubiquiti, Cisco, D-Link, Zyxel) preferred. New or used; local pickup only within 10 miles, otherwise ship to home. (User interview 2026-10-17.)

items.notes: Interview 2026-10-26: wants a desk-assistant arm, NOT a hobby/build project. Budget $200 (user). Under $200 new, everything is a hobby kit; factory-built arms were $300-600 used on eBay (2026-10-26) and $850-1000 new. Alerts at <= $200; price_max 700 so near misses show in the report. The daily run cannot read eBay (blocked), so eBay used listings need a manual check.
items.requirements: A factory-built desktop robot arm that works out of the box as a desk assistant, not a hobby kit to assemble and tinker with. Acceptable: UFACTORY uArm Swift Pro or Lite 6, Rotrics DexArm, Dobot Magician / Magician Lite, Elephant Robotics myCobot 280/320, WLKATA Mirobot, or similar from an established maker. Must use stepper motors with encoders or closed-loop servos (position feedback), roughly 0.5 mm repeatability or better, and about 250 g payload or more. Must be complete and working, including power supply and controller; incomplete kits, parts-only and accessory listings do not count. Not acceptable: hobby servo kits (Hiwonder xArm, LewanSoul/LeArm, Adeept, Acebott, aluminium 6DOF frames with MG996R servos), toy or hydraulic arms, and SO-101/LeRobot DIY arms that need 3D printing. Used is fine (a discontinued model is OK if complete). Budget about $200 total; local pickup within 50 miles of Milpitas, otherwise shipped. (User 2026-10-26.)
